text:
michael: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can someone clarify the expected timeline for EMEA GPU pool onboarding and whether autoscaler burst capacity will be available during the ramp? I heard 'end of Q2' but need concrete dates for customer comms.

emma: Short answer: target internal ready by end of June, soft opt-in July 1 for hosted customers. Public GA will depend on initial metrics. Burst policy: we plan an initial safe burst of ~20% of committed pool for the first 30 days, then adjust.

michael: thanks — do we have a public doc or just the internal roadmap? also will burst minutes be billed differently?

emma: roadmap + rollout doc (internal): https://go/redwood/infra/emea-rollout. Billing note: burst minutes will not count toward reserved-discount bands; billing team is drafting the exact wording.

li: Autoscaler detail from today's demo: initial autoscaler v2 config will include a "burst_window" and a conservative token_leak_rate. Example snippet:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  version: v2
  burst_window: 300s   # 5m
  burst_percent: 20
  fallback_order: [regional_hot_standby, cross_region]
  max_concurrent_per_node: 48
```
This keeps tail latency bounded during sudden spikes.

michael: can fallback_order do automatic failover to us-east if EMEA supply drops?

li: yes — we have automated routing rules. SRE needs to validate cross-region KV-cache behavior.

javier: Capacity update: procurement has 4 additional GPU hosts queued with our EMEA supplier; ETA to rack-by date is ~3 weeks. Staging->prod pipeline is ~2 weeks after rack. That aligns with emma's target. We also have a hot-standby agreement with a second cloud partner in-region for quick bursts.

sara: Product note: for Dedicated customers we'll surface a "guaranteed burst" addon (paid) vs the default free transient burst. Sales/AMs need clear collateral.

michael: good. any blockers on SRE validation?

li: One open item: end-to-end KV cache consistency across cross-region fallbacks under write-heavy workloads. I'll run a chaos test next week and post results.

deploy-bot: autoscaler/v2 deploy queued at 1729123500 — status: pending :gear:

emma: Action list I'm capturing: 1) publish rollout schedule doc by Tue EOD (I) ; 2) SRE (li) to run KV-cache cross-region chaos test and report; 3) Billing to finalize burst pricing language (javier to coordinate); 4) Product (sara) draft Dedicated burst addon copy for sales; 5) Ops to confirm hot-standby provider SLAs.

michael: please add owners + deadlines to the doc. tagging folks: @li @javier @sara. :thumbsup:

javier: I'll update the capacity tracker and ping billing.

li: Starting chaos tests Wednesday night — will post logs and perf summary here.

sara: I'll have a draft sales one-pager by Friday.

michael: perfect. if anyone needs me to escalate budget/procurement, ping me directly.

emma: thanks all. leaving the thread open for any post-call Qs.
